statement: A Control-Room-authorized non-Production local-dev Masaarat capture session exists for the Method A four-locale pilot lesson builder-m7-l1-tables-columns only (CR-LV-METHOD-A-FOUR-LOCALE-CAPTURE-PILOT-20260728-01). Other MASAARAT_SCREENSHOT lessons remain without authorized capture sessions.
consequence: runMasaaratScreenshotRoute still fails closed for pipeline modes that do not perform live capture. Live browser capture is executed only by mode=method-a-m7l1-four-pilot against http://127.0.0.1:55440/system-state.
howToAuthorizeCapture: To unblock a specific cell, a Control-Room-approved capture config file must be added at docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/capture/{lessonId}__{locale}.capture.json (or docs/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/capture/{lessonId}.capture.json to cover all locales) matching the schema documented in src/lib/lesson-visuals/controlled-v1/routes/masaaratScreenshot.ts, pointing at a non-Production environment/session.
